title: Welcome to the Numberworks

slides.title: Meet Tally
slides.text: Tally the cat keeps the Numberworks, the street of workshops in the little town of Netville where all the counting gets done. Tally knows every shelf, every scale and every stubborn drawer.

slides.title: Workshops gone quiet
slides.text: The workshops have gone quiet. Their shutters are shut, their tools are dusty, and the numbers inside have forgotten their jobs.

slides.title: Numbers have jobs
slides.text: A number is a tool. Like any tool, it does a job when you pick the right one and use it well.
steps: counting: how many seeds in the sack
measuring: how long is the ribbon
sharing: how much pie for each friend
paying: how much change is due

visual.label: Numbers at work: seeds, ribbon, pie, change

focus.cue: Counting: how many seeds are in the sack.
Sharing: how much pie for each friend.

slides.title: A giggle in the dark
slides.text: Somewhere behind the shutters, something giggles. A tile clatters. When Tally looks, two number tiles have swapped places. That is the Jumble, heard before it is ever seen.

visual.label: Two tiles swapped, 2 then 1, and swapped back, 1 then 2

focus.cue: These two tiles have swapped places: the 2 and the 1.
Swap them back and the tiles count 1, 2 in order again.

slides.title: Stretch: Numbers everywhere
slides.text: Numbers also keep scores, tell the time and name the pages of a book. One street, many jobs. You will meet them all, one workshop at a time.

focus.cue: Numbers keep scores: a score of 3.

words.means: a count or an amount, written with digits
one of the ten symbols 0 to 9 that build numbers
a place where a kind of work gets done
to find how long, heavy or full something is

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: There is no game this time. Open the course map, walk the Numberworks street, and find the Vault of Measures with its seven empty sockets.

talk: If you could give one number any job in the world, what job would you give it and why?
